body:
READ-ONLY MOVING-DELTA ADVISORY, not a formal successor review. I inspected the live rendered HTML at 127.0.0.1:8765 and the current dirty docs checkout. Visual QA remains unclaimed because the in-app browser client still resolves a removed service version; no browser process was started.

The new landing is a major comprehension improvement: the hero names the user, input, operation, and outputs; the Anna story/recall/table makes association, underspecification, uncertainty, and backward movement concrete before the evidence machinery. That addresses the central failure in 39c745d.

Three issues remain in the current moving bytes:

1. The landing says the library returns “summary measures with the text and coverage used to compute them.” `RecallSignature` carries measures, support carriers, per-unit IDs, modes and facets; it does not carry source or recall text. The text remains reachable only through separately retained input graphs/atlases and node identities. Suggested correction: “summary measures with their support and coverage; retained node and unit identities let callers inspect them against the source and recall inputs.” This matters because the output-bundle epic exists precisely to make text-bearing delivery explicit.

2. The hero action says “Run the Scala example” but links to `/scala/getting-started/`, whose complete workflow is SurfaceAtlas construction and SpanSet support. It does not run the Anna alignment shown on the landing page and contains no `GraphHsmm` or `AlignmentMatrix`. Rename the action to “Inspect source text in Scala,” or add an executable public alignment example matching the promise.

3. `/method/one-honest-success/` still paraphrases the WOG passage and then shows `assertEquals` plus `Vector.empty`; the actual quoted sentence is absent. That is the exact Q7 failure the chief named. If this page remains the WOG success page, put the twelve-word public-domain sentence and its three concrete model rows before the test scaffold, or remove the scaffold from the reader path.

The already-recorded receipt override and provenance-link blockers are still visible in this mutable checkout, but I am not re-reviewing them before a successor is frozen. No reserved file, candidate record, or review register was changed.
